licenses.text:
Wycliffe Bible, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/engWycliffe/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/engWycliffe/copyright.htm):
> This is the Pentateuch and Gospels from The Holy Bible, containing the Old and New Testaments, with the apocryphal books, in the earliest English version made from the latin Vulgate by John Wycliffe and his followers. c.1395
> Public Domain
> Language: Middle English (English)
> Dialect: Middle
> Translation by: John Wycliffe
> 2016-11-08

Why this is public domain:
Text: the later Wycliffite version (about 1395), Pentateuch and Gospels, as edited by Josiah Forshall (1795-1863) and Frederic Madden (1801-1873), Oxford, The University Press, 1850. Translators: John Wycliffe (1328-1384), John Purvey (about 1353-1428), Nicholas of Hereford (active 1382-1391). US: published before 1931. United Kingdom: life plus 70 years; the last named editor died in 1873. The digital transcription writes the letter yogh as "y", a mechanical change that adds no author.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=engWycliffe), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/engWycliffe/copyright.htm), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wycliffe%27s_Bible; https://archive.org/details/ENGW850_DBS_HS; English Wikipedia pages of Wycliffe and Madden; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries%27_copyright_lengths; https://copyright.cornell.edu/publicdomain.

held_out_by.note: eBible's chapter files, <code>_<NNN>_<BOOK>_<CC>_read.txt, are held out by book and chapter, so the same chapter is held out in every translation at once (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23)

note: eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside, so a rebuild with the same text still matches.
